_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base-rate dominates; 30d momentum ~50, flat leg and unconfirmed mini-top divergence give no clean UP/DOWN breaker, so skilled HOLD is the honest call.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/Hope; narrative silent on phase but inflow story leans mildly defensive, not a directional override
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound with 30d momentum pinned near 50 and funding neutral across next windows
next_move.invalidated_if: momentum breaks above ~65 with positive ETF flows (up toward Optimism) OR price loses range while netflow stays extreme and gold/VIX rise (down toward Disbelief)
